scope: Reviewed OMAI formula endpoints and exact Lean proof source for local theorems with no Physlib physics counterpart. Hash and compiled-name checks detect drift and provenance errors; they are not automatic symbolic translation or numerical validation.
interpretations: compute_static_dielectric is an opaque output in the catalog. The interpreted definition is eps_0 = eps_inf + c Z^T D^-1 Z, with D the Gamma-point dynamical matrix on the optical coordinates (the acoustic translations projected out, so D is positive definite for a stable crystal), Z the mass-weighted Born-charge matrix Z*_{kappa,alpha beta}/sqrt(M_kappa) on those coordinates, and c = 4 pi e^2/Omega in Gaussian units (e^2/(epsilon_vac Omega) in SI, epsilon_vac the vacuum permittivity). In the eigenbasis of D this is the mode-oscillator-strength sum sum_m Z~_m Z~_m^T/omega_m^2 over the polar modes that the catalog describes; it needs the Gamma eigenvectors through D, not only the frequencies the catalog lists as input.

With D positive definite and c > 0, eps_0 - eps_inf is positive semidefinite and u (eps_0 - eps_inf) u = 0 exactly when Z u = 0: the ionic term never lowers the response and vanishes along a direction exactly when no polar mode couples to it.

Along a direction u with u eps_inf u > 0, adding the Gonze-Lee long-wavelength correction c (Z u)(Z u)^T/(u eps_inf u) to D gives a Hermitian matrix whose eigenvalues are the longitudinal squared frequencies along u, and the product of these over the product of the eigenvalues of D equals (u eps_0 u)/(u eps_inf u): the generalized Lyddane-Sachs-Teller relation.

nonAnalytic transcribes the q -> 0 limit of the catalog's apply_nac_correction along the direction u of q: the term added to the dynamical matrix is c (Z u)(Z u)^T/(u eps_inf u) with c = 4 pi q_e^2/Omega (Gaussian units) and Z the mass-weighted Born-charge matrix, the Cartesian block of the atom pair being the outer product of the contracted Born charges over the scalar u . eps_inf . u. The finite-q Ewald sum of the gonze_lee scheme is a representation choice.
